Job Description
 We are looking for a Senior Application Security Analyst to lead complex application-security investigations and improve the services, processes, and practices used to manage application risk.
You will handle high-complexity incidents and vulnerability cases, guide other analysts, coordinate investigations across multiple stakeholders, and drive improvements to runbooks, telemetry, alert quality, and operational performance.
 Main responsibilities:
 Complex investigations and incident leadership
Lead high-complexity investigations involving applications, APIs, authentication systems, and internet-facing services
Form and test investigation hypotheses by correlating telemetry across multiple systems and data sources
Establish incident scope, timeline, root cause, attack path, affected assets, and potential business impact
Coordinate evidence gathering, analysis, handovers, and specialist contributions during significant incidents
Recommend containment and risk-reduction actions and provide clear technical context for decision-makers
Review investigation quality, risk assessments, and closure decisions for significant cases. 
Participate in or lead incident-response duties where required. 
 Advanced vulnerability analysis
Lead the validation and prioritization of complex or high-impact findings from security testing, bug bounty, incident response, and external disclosures
Assess exploitability, attack chains, exposure, asset criticality, affected data, and compensating controls
Identify patterns across incidents and vulnerabilities and recommend measures that address recurring root causes
Resolve ambiguous or disputed findings by presenting clear evidence and risk-based reasoning
 Guide stakeholders through difficult prioritization, escalation, and risk-acceptance decisions.
 Service and process improvement
Own and improve investigation procedures, runbooks, escalation paths, quality standards, and case-review practices
Identify gaps in telemetry and investigation capability and define clear requirements for the teams responsible for addressing them
Drive improvements to alert fidelity, investigation efficiency, reporting quality, and operational coverage
Develop advanced scripts, queries, and analytical methods for complex investigations and recurring use cases
Lead tabletop exercises, case reviews, and post-incident improvement activities
Use operational metrics and investigation outcomes to prioritize service improvements. 
 Technical leadership and collaboration
Act as a senior subject-matter expert for application-security investigations and vulnerability analysis
Mentor analysts and improve team capability through coaching, peer review, and knowledge sharing
Communicate complex technical findings and uncertainty clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Coordinate work across application owners, incident responders, security specialists, and leadership
Represent the application-security analysis function in complex cross-team discussions. 
 Job Requirements
5–8 years of relevant experience in application security, incident response, security operations, vulnerability research, penetration testing, or a related cybersecurity role
Extensive experience leading complex security investigations using SIEM and other telemetry platforms
Advanced ability to correlate data across multiple sources, reconstruct attack timelines, and determine root cause and business impact
Deep understanding of web application and API security, common attack techniques, and defensive controls
Strong experience validating complex vulnerabilities, attack chains, and evidence of exploitation
Advanced proficiency with web-security and investigation tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Elastic, Splunk, or equivalent platforms
Strong scripting capability in Python, Bash, or a similar language for investigation and operational automation
Demonstrated experience creating and improving runbooks, analytical methods, and incident-response processes
Strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to make risk-based decisions with incomplete or ambiguous information
Demonstrated ability to lead investigations, mentor analysts, and influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience with large-scale WAF, CDN, API gateway, authentication, cloud, or application telemetry
Experience with threat hunting, digital forensics, incident command, or purple-team activities
Experience developing investigation metrics, quality controls, or operational service reviews
Familiarity with CVSS, OWASP risk-rating methods, CWE, MITRE ATT&CK, or equivalent frameworks
Relevant certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GWAPT, GXPN, OSCP, OSWE, or equivalent practical experience. 
 What Success Looks Like
Complex incidents and vulnerabilities are handled with clear technical leadership and sound risk decisions
Investigations produce defensible conclusions on scope, impact, root cause, and required action
Analysts receive effective technical guidance and improve their independence over time
Runbooks, analytical methods, and quality standards improve based on operational evidence
Alert quality and investigation efficiency show measurable improvement
Senior stakeholders receive clear, timely, and decision-ready security analysis.
